abilities.name: Trample
abilities.text: Hits everyone standing near him.

abilities.name: Forked Lightning
abilities.text: Nature damage in a cone in front of her (2-second cast). Stay out of the cone.

abilities.name: Frost Nova
abilities.text: Freezes everyone near her in place for up to 8 seconds.

abilities.name: Slow
abilities.text: Slows a player's movement and attacks for 10 seconds.

abilities.name: Net
abilities.text: Roots a player in place for 10 seconds.

abilities.name: Lightning Shield
abilities.text: Lightning strikes anyone who touches him. A priest or shaman can remove it.

abilities.name: Lightning Bolt
abilities.text: He keeps his distance to cast it. Interrupt him.

baron-aquanis.trigger: Click the Fathom Stone in the water: he rises from it.

abilities.name: Frostbolt
abilities.text: He keeps his distance to cast it: Frost damage and a slow.

abilities.name: Frost Nova
abilities.text: Roots everyone near him for up to 8 seconds.

abilities.name: Sleep
abilities.text: Puts everyone near him to sleep for up to 10 seconds. Damage wakes a sleeper.

abilities.name: Mind Blast
abilities.text: Shadow damage on a player (1.5-second cast).

old-serra-kis.trigger: He waits in an underwater cave beneath Twilight Lord Kelris's temple, and many groups miss him. Swim under the temple to reach him.

aku-mai.trigger: Once Twilight Lord Kelris is dead, light the four Aku'Mai fires in his room, one after the other. Each one brings a wave of creatures. When they are all dead, Aku'Mai's door opens.

abilities.name: Poison Cloud
abilities.text: Nature damage every 5 seconds for 45 seconds to everyone nearby.

abilities.name: Frenzied Rage
abilities.text: Below 30% health: bursts of attacks 75% faster, over and over.

abilities.name: Net
abilities.text: Roots everyone near him for 10 seconds.

abilities.name: Slow
abilities.text: Slows a player's attacks and movement for 10 seconds, and can stun them.

abilities.name: Summon Mechanical Roach
abilities.text: Calls mechanical roaches. His Update kills them and heals him.

grubbis.trigger: Talk to Blastmaster Emi Shortfuse and protect her while she blows up the two cave entrances. Troggs come in waves, then Grubbis arrives with Chomper.

abilities.name: Megavolt
abilities.text: Nature damage in a cone in front of him (2-second cast). Only the tank stands in front.

abilities.name: Chain Lightning
abilities.text: A bolt that bounces between nearby players (2.5-second cast). Interrupt him.

abilities.name: Crowd Pummel
abilities.text: Hits everyone near him and interrupts their spells. Casters and healers, keep your distance.

abilities.name: Arcing Smash
abilities.text: Hits everyone in a cone in front of him.

abilities.name: Trample
abilities.text: Hits everyone standing near him.

abilities.name: Summon Fiery Servant
abilities.text: Calls two fiery servants at the start of the fight.

abilities.name: Fireball
abilities.text: He keeps his distance to cast it. Interrupt him.

abilities.name: Fire Shield II
abilities.text: Fire damage to everyone near him for one minute. A priest or shaman can remove it.

abilities.name: Walking Bombs
abilities.text: He lights the gnome heads around the room one by one, and each one drops walking bombs that explode when they reach a player. The button next to a head turns it off. Below half health, he lights them faster.

abilities.name: Knock Away
abilities.text: Knocks the tank back. Below half health, it hits everyone around him.

abilities.name: Curses and Diseases
abilities.text: Being able to remove a curse or cure a disease helps. Otherwise an easy fight: clear the room before engaging.

abilities.name: The Summoner
abilities.text: Kill the summoner first: he brings in reinforcements. Then the elemental.

abilities.name: Fire Everywhere
abilities.text: Area damage on the group, worse when the group fights a lot in melee.

abilities.name: Sent Across the Room
abilities.text: He sends players flying across the room. Clear the nearest groups and tank him near the tunnel, so nobody lands in another group.

abilities.name: Fear When Weakened
abilities.text: As his health drops, he terrifies the whole group. Bring something to break it, or clear the room beforehand so nobody runs into other enemies.

abilities.name: The Locked Vaults
abilities.text: After the fight, open the vaults in the room: about 24 Dwarven Heirlooms for Important Heirlooms, and the tablet for The Treaty of Understanding.

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.text: Hits his target and the player nearest to it.

abilities.name: Fire Nova
abilities.text: Fire damage to everyone near him, several times per fight. Healers, keep the melee topped up.

abilities.name: Uppercut
abilities.text: A heavy blow that knocks the tank back.

abilities.name: Immolate
abilities.text: Burns a player, then Fire damage every few seconds for 21 seconds. Interrupt the spell or dispel the burn.

abilities.name: Curse of Weakness
abilities.text: Reduces a player's physical damage for 30 seconds. A mage or druid can remove it.

abilities.name: Poison
abilities.text: His hits poison: Nature damage over time. Cure the poison if you can.

abilities.name: Sinister Strike
abilities.text: Extra damage on the tank every 5 to 15 seconds.

abilities.name: Thrown Into the Air
abilities.text: Throws the tank into the air and stuns them for 5 seconds. Watch your threat as damage dealer: the tank only holds him for about half the fight.

abilities.name: A Patrol
abilities.text: Clear his room before engaging: a patrol passes through. His head can be picked up for the quests Abominable Creatures and Unending Torment.

abilities.name: The Courtyard Spiders
abilities.text: Nothing special on the boss himself. Clear the other spiders in the courtyard first, or they join the fight.

the-abandoned.trigger: Clear the courtyard, click the statue and hold on through the waves: she arrives afterward.

abilities.name: Frost Nova
abilities.text: Frost damage on the whole group. If you heal, save mana for all the waves.

abilities.name: Knockback
abilities.text: He knocks back: clear the groups around him first, or you land in one of them.

abilities.name: Anti-Magic Shield
abilities.text: Protects himself against spells for a while.

abilities.name: Mighty Blows
abilities.text: He hits hard: keep the tank topped up.

abilities.name: Flame Shock
abilities.text: His main spell. It can be interrupted and stunned: coordinate interrupts and stuns with the group.

abilities.name: Lots of Health
abilities.text: The longest fight in the dungeon. Keep interrupting until the end.

viktor-the-vile.trigger: Clear the house and the statue, click the fireplace and hold on through the waves. He arrives after the last flesh golem.

abilities.name: Poison
abilities.text: Poisons his target. Watch the health bars.

abilities.name: Mighty Blows
abilities.text: He hits hard: keep the tank alive. Bring mana potions for the waves before him.

abilities.name: Soul Drain
abilities.text: Roots a player for 10 seconds and drains their health to heal himself. Interrupt the 2-second cast or dispel it.

abilities.name: Crooked Blow
abilities.text: The Fel Steed stuns everyone near it for 3 seconds, and they take more physical damage. The Shadow Charger has no special abilities.

abilities.name: Butcher Drain
abilities.text: Drains 350 mana from his target in melee: a tank with mana will feel it.

abilities.name: Veil of Shadow
abilities.text: Curses a player: healing they receive is reduced by 75% for 15 seconds. Remove it, especially on the tank.

abilities.name: Holy Light
abilities.text: Heals himself or an ally (2.5-second cast). Interrupt him.

abilities.name: Divine Shield
abilities.text: Makes him immune to all damage and spells for 10 seconds.

abilities.name: Hammer of Justice
abilities.text: Stuns a player for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Call for Help
abilities.text: When you engage him, he calls creatures within 30 yards. Clear around him first.

abilities.name: Howling Rage
abilities.text: At 60%, 40% and 20% health, his hits get stronger.

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.text: Hits his target and the player nearest to it.

abilities.name: Hamstring
abilities.text: Slows his target's movement for 10 seconds.

arugal-s-voidwalker.trigger: They arrive as a group of four after Fenrus the Devourer dies: Arugal appears briefly and summons them.

abilities.name: Dark Offering
abilities.text: Heals another Voidwalker. Kill them one at a time.

abilities.name: Toxic Saliva
abilities.text: Nature damage every 6 seconds and drained mana, for 2 minutes. Cure the poison.

abilities.name: Worg Reinforcements
abilities.text: The longer the fight lasts, the more worgs he has with him: a Bleak Worg after 30 to 45 seconds, then a Slavering Worg, then a Lupine Horror.

abilities.name: Void Bolt
abilities.text: A 3-second Shadow bolt on the tank, over and over. Interrupt him.

abilities.name: Arugal's Curse
abilities.text: Turns a player other than the tank into a Shadowfang Glutton that fights for him for 10 seconds. Remove the curse.

abilities.name: Shadow Port
abilities.text: He teleports between his ledge, the upper ledge and the stairs.

abilities.name: Thunderclap
abilities.text: When the tank reaches him: Nature damage and a 5-second stun around him.

abilities.name: Rhahk'Zor Slam
abilities.text: Hits the tank hard and stuns them for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Pierce Armor
abilities.text: Reduces the tank's armor by 75% for 20 seconds.

abilities.name: Runs for Help
abilities.text: At 15% health, he runs off to get help. Finish him before he gets away.

abilities.name: Terrify
abilities.text: Makes a player flee in fear for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Overwhelming Pain
abilities.text: Slows a player's casting by 35% for 15 seconds.

sneed.trigger: He pilots Sneed's Shredder and climbs out when it is destroyed.

abilities.name: Disarm
abilities.text: Disarms the tank for 6 seconds.

abilities.name: Molten Metal
abilities.text: Fire damage every 3 seconds for 15 seconds, with attacks and movement slowed. Interrupt the 2-second cast.

abilities.name: Smite Slam
abilities.text: At 66% then 33% health, he stuns everyone around him, then goes to his chest to swap weapons.

abilities.name: Thrash
abilities.text: With his two axes, from 66% health: extra attacks on the tank.

abilities.name: Smite's Mighty Blow
abilities.text: With his hammer, below 33% health: a heavy blow that stuns the tank for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Poisoned Harpoon
abilities.text: A 2-second cast: a hit, then Nature damage for one minute. Cure the poison.

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.text: Hits his target and the player nearest to it.

abilities.name: Thrash
abilities.text: Now and then, two extra attacks: heavy hits on the tank.

abilities.name: VanCleef's Allies
abilities.text: At half health, he calls two Defias Blackguards.

abilities.name: Acid Splash
abilities.text: Nature damage every 5 seconds for 30 seconds to everyone near him.

abilities.name: Cookie's Cooking
abilities.text: Below half health, he heals himself (2-second cast). Interrupt him.

abilities.name: Runs for Help
abilities.text: At 15% health, he runs off to get help. Finish him before he gets away.

abilities.name: Shield Bash
abilities.text: Hits the tank and stuns them for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Runs for Help
abilities.text: At 15% health, he runs off to get help. Finish him before he gets away.

abilities.name: Runs for Help
abilities.text: At 15% health, he runs off to get help. Finish him before he gets away.

abilities.name: Thrash
abilities.text: Now and then, two extra attacks: heavy hits on the tank.

abilities.name: Enrage
abilities.text: At 30% health, he attacks 30% faster until the end of the fight.

abilities.name: Chain Lightning
abilities.text: A bolt that bounces from player to player (2-second cast). Interrupt him.

abilities.name: Bloodlust
abilities.text: Speeds up his attacks or an ally's by 30% for 30 seconds. A priest or shaman can remove it.

abilities.name: Smoke Bomb
abilities.text: Stuns everyone near him for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Battle Shout
abilities.text: More attack power for him and his allies for 2 minutes.

abilities.name: Runs for Help
abilities.text: At 15% health, he runs off to get help. Finish him before he gets away.

abilities.name: Lightning Bolt
abilities.text: He keeps his distance to cast it. Interrupt him.

abilities.name: Healing Touch
abilities.text: Heals himself or an ally (3-second cast). Interrupt him.

abilities.name: Cobrahn's Serpent Form
abilities.text: At 30% health, he turns into a snake: slower but heavier hits, and he starts putting players to sleep.

abilities.name: Healing Touch
abilities.text: Heals herself or an ally. Interrupt her.

abilities.name: Sleep
abilities.text: Puts a player to sleep for up to 20 seconds. Damage wakes them, and a Dispel Magic removes it.

abilities.name: Thorns
abilities.text: Nature damage to anyone who hits her in melee.

abilities.name: Thunderclap
abilities.text: Nature damage to everyone near him, then attacks and movement slowed for 10 seconds.

abilities.name: Healing Touch
abilities.text: Heals himself or an ally. Interrupt him.

abilities.name: Sleep
abilities.text: Puts a player to sleep for up to 20 seconds.

abilities.name: Shell Shield
abilities.text: For 12 seconds, he takes 60% less damage and attacks slower but harder.

abilities.name: Chained Bolt
abilities.text: A bolt that bounces to a second player. Interrupt him.

abilities.name: Healing Touch
abilities.text: A slow heal (3.5 seconds) on himself or an ally. Interrupt him.

abilities.name: Sleep
abilities.text: Puts a player to sleep for up to 20 seconds.

abilities.name: Lightning Bolt
abilities.text: He keeps his distance to cast it. Interrupt him.

abilities.name: Grasping Vines
abilities.text: When his target is close, he knocks down and roots everyone near him for 10 seconds. At range, keep your distance.

mutanus-the-devourer.trigger: Kill Lady Anacondra, Lord Cobrahn, Lord Pythas and Lord Serpentis, then talk to the Disciple of Naralex at the entrance and escort him to Naralex. Protect him during the ritual: Mutanus arrives at the end.

abilities.name: Thunderclap
abilities.text: Nature damage to everyone near him and a 2.5-second stun.

abilities.name: Naralex's Nightmare
abilities.text: Puts a player to sleep for up to 15 seconds.

abilities.name: Terrify
abilities.text: Makes a player flee in fear for 4 seconds.
